rules.title: LA JCO: no termination of tenancy without just cause
rules.requirement: For tenancies covered by the Los Angeles Just Cause Ordinance (most residential units not regulated by the Rent Stabilization Ordinance), a landlord may not terminate the tenancy without just cause. The page lists at-fault reasons (e.g., nonpayment, uncured lease violation, nuisance or damage, illegal use, refusal of reasonable access) and no-fault reasons (e.g., owner or family move-in, demolition or removal from the rental market, government order to vacate).
rules.citation: LAHD, Just Cause For Eviction Ordinance (JCO) webpage (https://housing.lacity.gov/residents/just-cause-for-eviction-ordinance-jco); ordinance section number not stated in captured text
rules.quoted_span: It prohibits terminations of tenancies without just cause
rules.exemptions: Page says the JCO applies once the tenant has lived in the unit at least six months or the original lease expired, whichever comes first. Exceptions include, but are not limited to, transient hotels, licensed care facilities, fraternity or sorority houses, owner's roommate, certain cooperatives, some non-profit homeless facilities or short-term substance-abuse treatment centers, and some HACLA or government-owned properties. The page also says the JCO can apply to buildings newer than October 1, 1978 and to a property containing only one single-family dwelling.
rules.interaction: The page says the JCO covers properties not regulated by the Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO). The JCO does not regulate rent increases.

rules.title: LA JCO: relocation assistance for no-fault evictions
rules.requirement: The JCO requires relocation assistance for no-fault evictions, such as owner or family move-in, demolition or removal from the rental market, or a government order to vacate. Tenants evicted for at-fault reasons are not entitled to relocation assistance. The captured text does not state the amount or the exact conditions.
rules.citation: LAHD, Just Cause For Eviction Ordinance (JCO) webpage (https://housing.lacity.gov/residents/just-cause-for-eviction-ordinance-jco); ordinance section number not stated in captured text
rules.quoted_span: requires relocation assistance for no-fault evictions
rules.exemptions: Same JCO coverage exceptions as the just cause rule. The page also says the owner 'may have to pay' relocation assistance for no-fault reasons, so the specific conditions need review.
rules.interaction: Tenants at fault for the eviction are not entitled to relocation assistance, per the page.

rules.title: LA: no nonpayment eviction unless rent owed exceeds Fair Market Rent
rules.requirement: For RSO and JCO rental units, a landlord may not evict a tenant for falling behind in rent unless the amount owed is higher than the Fair Market Rent (FMR) for the unit's bedroom size.
rules.citation: LAHD, Just Cause For Eviction Ordinance (JCO) webpage (https://housing.lacity.gov/residents/just-cause-for-eviction-ordinance-jco); ordinance section number not stated in captured text
rules.quoted_span: Effective March 27, 2023, landlords may not evict a tenant who falls behind in rent unless the tenant owes an amount higher than the Fair Market Rent (FMR).
rules.key_value: Rent owed must exceed the FMR for the unit's bedroom size (FMR dollar amounts not stated)
rules.interaction: The page says this applies to all RSO and JCO rental units.

rules.title: LA: file eviction notices with LAHD within three business days
rules.requirement: For JCO and RSO rental properties, all eviction notices issued to tenants must be filed with LAHD within three business days of service on the tenant.
rules.citation: LAHD, Just Cause For Eviction Ordinance (JCO) webpage (https://housing.lacity.gov/residents/just-cause-for-eviction-ordinance-jco); ordinance section number not stated in captured text
rules.quoted_span: All eviction notices issued to tenants in the City of Los Angeles must be filed with LAHD within three (3) business days of service on the tenant.
rules.interaction: The page says this applies to all JCO and RSO rental properties.
